Name: grapeponta's Vanilla Interiors (VPR interiors only)
Author: grapeponta
Description:
This is a retexture mod that (de?)hue-shifts all vanilla interiors and furniture a little to decrease contrast, saturation, and brightness (and reduce the overall yellow/purple complementary color scheme). Originally a part of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url], the interior tilesheets are now also in this separate mod for use with other outdoor recolors.

If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], make sure to download the additional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7213]VPR for SVE[/url] content pack as well (and set the "Outdoors" & "Snow Overlays" config options to false)!

[u]1.9 Update:[/u][list]
[*]Recolored new furniture & decor
[*]Sitting furniture fix (1.9.1)
[/list]
[u]Config Options: true/false; true by default[/u]
[list]
[*][color=#93c47d]Town Interiors[/color]: recolors all building interiors except the farmhouse & sheds.
[*][color=#93c47d]Walls and Floors[/color]: recolors wallpaper and flooring options for the farmhouse & sheds.
[*][color=#93c47d]Furniture[/color]: recolors furniture for the farmhouse & sheds.
[/list]
